name: Move bars left and right
wortlaut: I also want to grab a bar and move it left and right
wortlautDeutsch: Ich möchte einen Balken auch greifen und nach links und rechts verschieben können
kurz: You can now grab a bar by its body and move it left or right in its own row in 5-minute steps; its duration stays the same. If you drop it on another row, only the agent changes as before and the time stays.
